caption: Ngwa Nforbi v. Njiomouo
rule: No remedy becomes a filing candidate until Njiubu authorizes it and the trigger facts, timeliness, evidence, forum, and requested relief are verified.

trigger_facts: a current statutory act of abuse
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; Maryland District or circuit court; commissioner when court is closed
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Protective relief is act- and recency-sensitive; no general damages limitation substitutes for current need.
cautions: Emotional or psychological abuse alone is not a listed ground.
HB 1586 coercive-control proposal was not enacted as of research date.

trigger_facts: pending alimony, annulment, or divorce action
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; circuit court family case
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Requires the underlying family action; not an automatic consequence of filing.
cautions: Not a substitute for emergency protective-order relief.

authority: Md. Code, Pub. Safety Title 5; Maryland Judiciary ERPO process
relief: temporary or final firearm surrender and possession restrictions
remedies.actor_forum: eligible petitioner; District Court or commissioner
remedies.urgency: immediate only on concrete firearm-risk facts
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Current-risk remedy.
cautions: Not a general no-contact order.

trigger_facts: six-month separation, irreconcilable differences, or mutual consent
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; circuit court where venue lies
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Six-month ground requires uninterrupted separation before filing; separate lives can occur under one roof.
cautions: Confirm foreign or out-of-state proceedings and residency requirements.

relief: pendente lite, rehabilitative, or qualifying indefinite alimony
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; circuit court family case
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Award begins no earlier than the pleading requesting alimony.
cautions: Indefinite alimony has demanding additional criteria.

remedies.actor_forum: either spouse; circuit court family case
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Must be requested and developed in the family case.
cautions: Filing alone does not freeze assets.
Do not move or conceal property.

relief: temporary or final use and possession
remedies.actor_forum: eligible spouse; circuit court
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Statutory purpose and duration limits apply.
cautions: Do not assume availability without child/family-use predicates.

remedies.actor_forum: party; circuit court
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Tied to family proceedings and statutory findings.
cautions: Not automatic fee shifting.

relief: punitive damages only if actual malice is proved
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; District or circuit court based on amount and relief
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Civil assault: one year; battery generally screened under the three-year rule unless another provision controls.
cautions: Historic acts may be time-barred as standalone claims.

relief: possible punitive damages on required proof
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; civil court
remedies.limitations_or_timing: General three-year rule ordinarily applies; verify accrual and any exception.
cautions: Fear or relationship control alone is not necessarily confinement.

relief: possible punitive damages on required proof
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; civil court
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Exact act and accrual analysis required.
cautions: Maryland sets a very high threshold; ordinary cruelty is insufficient.

trigger_facts: wrongful dominion, detention, entry, or damage
remedies.actor_forum: owner or person entitled to possession; District or circuit court
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Claim-specific accrual; general three-year rule often relevant.
cautions: Marital title and family-court jurisdiction may affect remedy.

trigger_facts: specific false statement or actionable concealment
relief: rescission or equitable relief where available
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; civil court
remedies.limitations_or_timing: General three-year rule; fraudulent concealment may defer accrual only on proof of concealment and diligence.
cautions: Do not plead fraud generally or use concealment tolling as an assumption.

trigger_facts: Njiubu is at least 68 or a susceptible adult
Patrick occupied statutory trust/confidence relationship or otherwise qualifies
remedies.actor_forum: victim or authorized statutory representative; circuit court likely for full equitable relief
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Generally five years after discovery or when exploitation should have been discovered; statutory criminal-prosecution tolling.
cautions: Bad-faith fee exposure exists.
Joint-account status does not end the analysis but requires tracing.

remedies.actor_forum: person whose communication was unlawfully intercepted, disclosed, or used; civil court
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Limitations and discovery require counsel analysis.
cautions: Maryland generally requires prior consent of all parties for a participant recording.
Do not create new violations while collecting proof.

relief: civil defamation per se or invasion-of-privacy relief
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu and public authorities; civil and criminal forums
remedies.urgency: preserve without republishing; seek removal/safety help
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Special criminal limitations rule; civil claim limitations must be separately classified.
cautions: Do not place intimate media in git or circulate it for proof.

remedies.actor_forum: directly affected person; civil court and public authorities
remedies.urgency: preserve device and scene; address immediate surveillance
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Civil and criminal time limits require act-date classification.
cautions: Not every household camera meets the elements.

trigger_facts: unauthorized access, copying, alteration, damage, or qualifying misuse
remedies.actor_forum: directly injured person; civil court and public authorities
remedies.urgency: change access safely; preserve forensic evidence
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Civil limitations and special criminal limit require verification.
cautions: Shared devices, passwords, and prior authorization complicate proof.
No retaliatory account access.

trigger_facts: serious injury, strangulation, firearm use, assault, or reckless substantial risk facts
remedies.actor_forum: police, commissioner, State's Attorney, criminal court
remedies.urgency: immediate after current violence or injury
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Classification determines the prosecution period; report promptly.
cautions: The State controls prosecution.
Do not inflate charge classification.

trigger_facts: reasonable fear or serious emotional distress
repeated communications or tracking as statute requires
remedies.actor_forum: police, commissioner, State's Attorney
remedies.urgency: document each contact and location event
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Stalking has a special longer prosecution period; other misdemeanors may have shorter periods.
cautions: Preserve originals; do not engage to manufacture evidence.

trigger_facts: destruction, theft, identity fraud, or exploitation
remedies.actor_forum: police, commissioner, State's Attorney
remedies.urgency: freeze credit and preserve records lawfully if identity or asset risk exists
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Offense-specific classification and limitations.
cautions: § 7-110 restricts theft prosecution between spouses unless its exception applies.
Civil and family property rights may differ from criminal ownership.

trigger_facts: unlawful restraint or qualifying threat used to obtain or compel
specific statutory object and mental state
remedies.actor_forum: police, commissioner, State's Attorney
remedies.urgency: immediate if restraint or threats continue
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Classify exact offense and prosecution period.
cautions: Relationship pressure alone does not establish kidnapping or extortion.

trigger_facts: physical injury, neglect, or intentionally and maliciously inflicted severe emotional distress
remedies.actor_forum: police, Adult Protective Services, State's Attorney
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Offense-specific period; second-degree provision has a special period that must be verified at report date.
cautions: Age alone does not equal vulnerable-adult status.

trigger_facts: threat, harm, inducement, or obstruction tied to reporting, testimony, or official process
remedies.actor_forum: police and State's Attorney
remedies.urgency: report promptly to the assigned authority
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Act- and offense-specific.
cautions: Requires the statutory connection to official process.

trigger_facts: suspected abuse, neglect, self-neglect, or exploitation
relief: emergency response where criteria are met
remedies.actor_forum: any reporter; local department of social services
remedies.urgency: 24-hour emergency track or ordinary statutory response depending on risk
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Current protection focus.
cautions: Not a substitute for 911 in an emergency.
Do not equate older age with vulnerability.

trigger_facts: direct property, medical, injury, or wage loss
remedies.actor_forum: prosecutor and criminal court; victim supplies documentation
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Request within the criminal process.
cautions: No duplicate recovery; restitution does not bar a civil suit.

trigger_facts: physical injury or qualifying psychological injury
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; Criminal Injuries Compensation Board
remedies.urgency: file promptly; verify current period and exceptions
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Statutory filing period and good-cause provisions apply.
cautions: Benefits are capped and offset; not a tort award.

trigger_facts: qualifying domestic-violence, sexual-assault, or stalking purpose
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; employer and Maryland labor process
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Notice and verification rules may apply.
cautions: Coverage and accrual must be verified.

trigger_facts: tenant or lawful occupant is a qualifying victim
required protective order or documentation and notice
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; landlord and, if disputed, court
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Follow exact notice, document, and move-out requirements.
cautions: Improper notice can preserve rent liability.

remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; Maryland Address Confidentiality Program
remedies.urgency: before new filings or move where possible
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Prospective program process.
cautions: Does not erase prior public records.

trigger_facts: left employment because of domestic violence
relief: possible unemployment eligibility despite voluntary separation
remedies.actor_forum: Njiubu; Maryland unemployment agency
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Agency filing and weekly-certification rules apply.
cautions: Eligibility remains fact- and agency-specific.

trigger_facts: federal eligibility reviewed by immigration counsel
relief: Maryland certification decision supporting a federal application
remedies.actor_forum: victim or representative; Maryland certifying official
remedies.limitations_or_timing: Maryland certification request is not barred by a limitations period; federal rules control the petition.
cautions: Certification does not establish federal eligibility.
VAWA and U-visa merits are federal, not Maryland causes of action.
